title: I Built A Tool That Tracks Insider Trades
author: Useful-Laugh-7986
selftext:
Ever since learning About **Deep F\*cking Value** 5 years ago Insider Trading has been a main component of my DD.

(and so far its doing pretty well, im up **53% across my whole portfolio**)

But most softwares out there are either really dated and clunky (openinsider), lack a ton of data (quiverquant) or just doesnt allow you to create custom filters and strategys (finviz).

So i decided to create my own! Its called [**Kestrelterminal.com**](http://Kestrelterminal.com)

Its free to use and signup, the only paid part is our **Custom Insider Algo** that me and my team build **(what i used to grow my account on the 2nd image).**

**If youd like to try out the paid alerts/custom algo for free just lmk in the comments and ill hook you up.**
